location_description: Beaux Arts () is a town located in the Eastside region of King County, Washington, United States. It is the smallest municipality in the county, with a population of 299 as of the 2010 census and a land area of 0.1 sq mi. There is no town hall, with official city business meetings taking place in private homes.The town, a suburb of Seattle and Bellevue, is one of the most affluent areas in the metropolitan area.
